subject: general
question: Sal and teak are the most important _______ trees.
solution:
The correct answer is__** deciduous**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Deciduous Trees**

 
 
• **Trees that lose their leaves** for a part of the year are said to be **deciduous trees**.
 
• **Abscission **is the process of losing useless portions, like leaves.
 
• All around the world, they can be found in both** temperate and tropical areas**. 
 
• Deciduous trees have broad, flat leaves that are very light-catching and require a large amount of water.
 
• **Winter can sometimes coincide with leaf loss**, especially in temperate or polar regions where there is less sunlight available for photosynthesis.
 
• Deciduous trees lose their leaves in various parts of the world during the dry season or other seasons, depending on** variations in rainfall, including tropical, subtropical, and arid climates**.
 
• As a strategy for surviving difficult times, this enables the trees to go into **dormancy**. 
 
• Some **most important deciduous trees** are:
 
 
• **Sal**
 
• **Teak**
 
• Oak
 
• Sandalwood
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pioneer Trees**

 
 
• Pioneer trees and plants are the species that emerge when nature is allowed to reign; they are often the **first to colonize an area of land that has been damaged or degraded**.
 
• Typically, they are** robust, native species that are well adapted to the local environment and surroundings**.
 
• Examples: **Lichens, **fireweed, grasses, **fungi, bacteria, and willow**.
 
 
 
• **Coniferous Trees**
 
 
• Common softwood tree species known as coniferous trees are distinguished by their** pine-like needle leaves and seed-bearing cones**.
 
• Although some conifers are deciduous and lose their leaves in the fall, the **majority of conifer species are evergreen**.
 
• Examples: **Pine trees, Spruce trees, and Fir trees**.
 
 
 
• **Medicinal Trees**
 
 
• Any plant used for **medicinal, tonic, purgative, or other health-promoting purposes** is known as a medicinal plant.
 
• This includes **roots, leaves, seeds, bark, and other plant parts**.
 
• Examples: **Tulsi, Neem, Ginkgo, Sassafras**, etc.
